task: billing/tenant boundary privacy audit; document and audit multi-tenant billing aggregation, ensuring telemetry and usage metrics are isolated by tenant_id without cross-tenant metadata disclosure.

verified_source_anchors.description: Per-surface usage counter across chat, research, scribe, careguard, council, and selfmed.
Aggregated product and usage analytics shape with explicit has_data indicator for honest empty states.
Aggregates usage metrics from platform tables over range windows.
Operational metrics contract enforcing allowlisted enums and bounded numeric counters.
Comprehensive denylist of clinical and identity fields stripped from telemetry rails.
UniqueConstraint on (tenant_id, operation_kind, idempotency_key) establishing tenant-partitioned idempotency.
Explicit tenant_id column supporting multi-tenant domain models.
Append-only compliance audit event model with PII-free metadata.
Cryptographic privacy audit receipt recording scope_digest, artifact_digest, and finding counts.
Thread-safe in-process HTTP metrics store recording counts and status codes.

interface_assumptions: Tenant usage meter events are partitioned strictly by tenant_id in both in-memory buffers and database tables.
Triple-key idempotency deduplication on (tenant_id, meter_kind, idempotency_key) prevents duplicate billing without cross-tenant key collisions.
BOLA/IDOR protection on billing objects returns 404 Not Found to prevent resource enumeration and metadata disclosure.
Billing line-items and telemetry meters contain exclusively allowlisted computational units (tokens, seconds, pages, requests, cents, tier) and zero clinical or patient PHI.
Per-tenant token bucket rate limiting prevents side-channel throughput and quota exhaustion inference by peer tenants.
Audit test vectors execute completely hermetically in-memory with zero external network or persistent database requirements.

test_commands_and_exit_codes.description: Execution of 44 multi-tenant billing boundary privacy audit vectors across 7 test suites (100% pass).
Hermetic runner executing full billing privacy audit suite with structured JSON telemetry summary.
